newsitem.title: UK: Key closing stock market indices, Aug 30.
newsitem.headline: Key closing stock market indices, Aug 30.

text.p: Here is how major stock markets outside the United States ended on Friday.

LONDON - Leading shares finished the week sharply lower as renewed fears about a hike in U.S. interest rates after more strong U.S. economic data sent the market tumbling. The FTSE 100 fell 17.4 points to end at 3,867.7, a loss of 39.8 since last Friday.

FRANKFURT - Equities ended electronic trade on the IBIS DAX index more than half a percentage point lower after Wall Street opened sharply lower. The IBIS DAX index ended the day down at 2,534.49 points. Earlier, the DAX index of 30 German blue-chips took its cue from an overnight slide on Thursday's Wall Street to end floor trade down 16.23 points at 2,543.83 points. This was down 11.33 since last Friday.

PARIS - Shares ended weaker amid continued bearish sentiment over the French budget and labour outlook and expected poor corporate results. The blue-chip CAC-40 index finished down 6.95 points at 1,970.61, and was down 50.21 on the week.

ZURICH - Shares fell sharply, hit by declines in U.S. markets following release of stronger than expected economic data. Shares ended down roughly one percent and near the day's lows. Few investors were willing to take positions ahead of the Labor Day weekend in the U.S. The all-share SPI fell 18.04 points, or 0.76 percent, to 2,342.99, down 39.21 on the week.

TOKYO - The stock market's key Nikkei average tumbled nearly two percent, extending its losses for a third straight day. With few factors to buy on, brokers said the key index could slip below the 20,000 level in the near future. The key 225-share Nikkei average tumbled 386.26 points or 1.88 percent to close at 20,166.90, a drop of 1,061.9 on the week.

HONG KONG - Stocks fell through support to end sharply lower, as an overnight drop in U.S. stocks and bonds shook sentiment in the local market and share placements weighed on prices. The Hang Seng index fell 169.19 points to close at 11,159.02, down 265.62 from last week.

SYDNEY - The share market ended lower, driven down by Thursday's drop in the Dow Jones index after interest rate fears were reignited on Wall Street. The All Ordinaries index closed 10.6 points down at 2,268.7, a fall of 24.2 since last Friday.

JOHANNESBURG - The weaker than expected start on Wall Street pressured South African shares, dragging them off the ground they struggled to win after the morning's slide to finish softer on the day. The overall index was off 15.1 points at 6,688.9, up 124.7 from last Friday. Industrials were off 18.6 points to 7,835.2, a rise of 101.4 from a week ago and golds fell 21.1 to 1,787.6, up 47.4 on the week.
